title: Create @archmap/lifecycle plugin
description: Create the lifecycle workspace package and installer that registers the MVP schema, relation vocabulary, validators, and view definitions as one plugin.
decision_notes: Lifecycle is an Apache-2.0 workspace package with @archmap/core as a peer dependency; Core imports no lifecycle vocabulary.
installLifecycle() targets the backward-compatible default instance while createArchMap().use(lifecycle) remains isolated.
Schema, relations, one validator extension point, and three preliminary views install as one versioned plugin.
YAML parsing, actionable diagnostics, and relation-aware final views remain TASK-102, TASK-103, and TASK-105 respectively.
verification: isolated packed Core + Lifecycle Node ESM consumer = consumer ESM OK
